method.scanner_selection: Primary signal frozen at first capture; no later market substitution
method.production_calendar_policy: Only successful league feeds from a calendar snapshot no older than 36 hours can create new forecasts or update kickoffs; settlement remains independent of calendar availability
method.note: Forecasts use only the archived inputs available at capture. Results arrive with historical refreshes. Earlier historical backtests are not included. Baselines, code versions and inputs are frozen with each forecast.
